name: Shandong Meichen Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Meichen Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, and sale of various fluid delivery system products and suspension vibration reduction system products in China. The company develops and produces automotive fluid delivery, vibration damping rubber, automotive suspension damping, and thermal management system products. It also engages in the landscaping business, which includes ancient architecture, real estate landscaping, cultural tourism, and green space maintenance activities.
